en_title: Xbox Insiders Can Now Stream Games by Buying Cloud Playtime Without Game Pass, Introductory Launch Pricing Revealed
cn_title: XBOX云游戏试行免订阅购买时长
subtitle: 按时长付费
opus_summary: 微软已向XBOX预览计划成员开放云游戏时长购买，无需订阅Game Pass，下月将扩大开放范围。订阅用户也将面临每月云游戏时长限制，超出后需另购时长。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft is now letting Xbox Insiders stream games by buying cloud playtime without a Game Pass subscription.
paragraphs.cn: 微软现已允许XBOX预览计划成员直接购买云游戏时长，无需订阅Game Pass即可通过串流游玩。

paragraphs.en: This preview is designed to give Insiders an early look at the new option before it rolls out more broadly next month. Insiders can buy cloud playtime, stream games on supported devices, and share feedback to help us continue improving the experience.
paragraphs.cn: 这次预览旨在让预览计划成员提前体验这种新方式，下个月将向更多用户开放。预览计划成员可以购买云游戏时长，在支持的设备上通过串流游玩，并提供反馈，帮助我们持续改善体验。

paragraphs.en: Cloud playtime is available to Insiders at introductory launch pricing:
paragraphs.cn: 预览计划成员可按首发优惠价购买云游戏时长：

paragraphs.en: These cloud playtime packs let you play ad-free, and include shorter wait times, high-quality streaming, and playtime that remains available until it's used, Microsoft said. Insiders can also try cloud gaming for free with ads, as another option for accessing cloud gaming without a Game Pass subscription.
paragraphs.cn: 微软表示，购买这些云游戏时长包后，玩家可以无广告游玩，享受更短的排队时间和高质量串流，时长在用完之前一直有效。预览计划成员也可以免费观看广告来体验云游戏，这是另一种无需订阅Game Pass即可使用云游戏的方式。

paragraphs.en: The cloud gaming options for Game Pass subscribers Microsoft announced last month are still set for November. From next month, Game Pass plans will include a set number of cloud gaming hours each month:
paragraphs.cn: 微软上个月公布的Game Pass订阅用户云游戏方案仍定于11月推出。从下个月起，Game Pass各档订阅每月将包含固定的云游戏时长：

paragraphs.en: Xbox Game Pass cloud gaming monthly limits:
paragraphs.cn: XBOX Game Pass云游戏每月时长上限：

paragraphs.en: Once subscribers use their included hours, they can buy additional cloud playtime through the Xbox Store. Currently, Game Pass subscribers can stream without these monthly hour limits. The change means those who use cloud gaming most via Game Pass will end up having to pay more, although Microsoft said this impacts 4% of Game Pass subscribers.
paragraphs.cn: 订阅用户用完套餐内时长后，可以通过XBOX商店额外购买云游戏时长。目前，Game Pass订阅用户通过串流游玩不受这些每月时长上限限制。调整后，通过Game Pass使用云游戏最多的用户最终将不得不支付更多费用，不过微软表示，受影响的用户占Game Pass订阅用户的4%。

paragraphs.en: Cloud gaming has become a focus as the RAMpocalypse makes console gaming increasingly expensive. Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, recently predicted the video game industry will be in “commercial streaming mode” within three years — but for video game streaming to matter, it would have to run GTA 6 just as well as consoles do.
paragraphs.cn: 内存危机让主机游戏的成本越来越高，云游戏也因此成为焦点。Rockstar母公司Take-Two的掌舵人Strauss Zelnick近日预测，电子游戏行业将在三年内进入「商业化串流模式」——但游戏串流要发挥作用，就必须能让《GTA6》运行得和主机上一样好。

paragraphs.en: During an investor focused Q&A following the release of Take-Two’s latest financial report, Zelnick was asked for his thoughts on the video game industry as it buckles under the pressure of skyrocketing chip costs, which have forced Sony and Microsoft to raise the price of their consoles and potentially delay the launches of the PlayStation 6 and the next-gen Xbox, codenamed Project Helix.
paragraphs.cn: Take-Two发布最新财报后，在面向投资者的问答环节中，有人请Zelnick谈谈对电子游戏行业现状的看法。芯片成本飙升正让行业不堪重负，索尼和微软已被迫提高主机售价，PlayStation 6与代号为Project Helix的下一代XBOX也可能因此推迟推出。

paragraphs.en: Zelnick admitted the rising cost of hardware “is not a good thing,” because cheaper hardware means more hardware in people’s hands, which is what software companies desire. But he suggested the advent of video game streaming would go a long way to tackling this problem.
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick承认，硬件成本上涨「不是件好事」，因为硬件越便宜，就会有越多人拥有硬件，而这正是软件公司所希望的。不过，他认为游戏串流的出现将大大有助于解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: Both Sony and Microsoft are predicted to lean heavily on streaming in the coming years as they contend with the RAMpocalypse. “I just don't have any insight as to what the console manufacturers have planned, but it wouldn't at all surprise me if part of what they plan is streaming,” Zelnick offered.
paragraphs.cn: 外界预计，索尼和微软未来几年在应对内存危机时，都会大力倚重串流。Zelnick表示：「我并不了解主机厂商有什么计划，但如果串流是他们计划的一部分，我一点也不会感到意外。」

paragraphs.en: Just this week, it was reported that the next-gen Xbox may cost as much as $1,800 , with a new handheld rumored for next year. New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said the spiralling cost of new and existing consoles would require "radically different business models" over the coming generation. She added that the industry had "reached a point where it will be hard to imagine" mass audiences still being able to afford "thousands of dollars" for a new console generation.
paragraphs.cn: 就在本周，有报道称下一代XBOX售价可能高达1,800美元(约合人民币1万元)，另有传闻称明年将推出一款新掌机。XBOX新任CEO Asha Sharma表示，新旧主机的成本不断攀升，下一代主机将需要「截然不同的商业模式」。她补充说，行业已经「到了很难想象」大众消费者仍能为新一代主机负担「数千美元(约合人民币数万元)」的地步。

paragraphs.en: The current PS5 and Xbox Series X and S generation of consoles have seen price increases rather than cost savings. Sony itself raised the price of PS5 consoles back in March , blaming “continued pressures in the global economic landscape.” Nintendo has also not been immune, and recently acknowledged it would up the price of Switch 2, just over a year after its arrival. And Valve has bemoaned its struggle to release Steam Machine at the price it had initially hoped , instead having to go for an eye-watering $1,049.
paragraphs.cn: 当前这一代PS5和XBOX Series主机都经历了涨价而非降价。索尼早在今年3月就已上调PS5售价，理由是「全球经济形势持续承压」，任天堂同样未能幸免，近期也承认将在Switch 2上市一年多一点后提价。Valve亦苦恼于无法以最初期望的价格推出Steam Machine，最终不得不定出1049美元(约合人民币7091元)这样令人肉疼的价格。
